CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H. C. MISHRA

 For the Petitioners : Mr. R.C.P. Sah, Advocate  For the State : A.P.P.
 ------
6/ 18.02.2015 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.
The petitioners are apprehending their arrests in connection with G.O.Case No. 79 of 2014, for the alleged offences under Sections 48 and 59(iv) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
There is recovery of Pan Parag extra plus Tobacco from the shop of the petitioners, which was unsafe and injurious to health.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in this case and the sale of Pan Parag extra plus Tobacco is not banned in this State.

Learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and has produced the notification issued by the Principal Secretary to the Government-cum-State Food Safety Commissioner, in which, sale and storage of Gutkha and Pan Masala containing Tobacco or Nicotine is prohibited in the State of Jharkhand.
In the facts of this case, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to petitioners, Chunnu Kamila and Pintu Kamila.
Accordingly, their prayer for anticipatory bail is rejected.

( H. C. Mishra, J.) R.Kr.
